fullDescription: A brutalist, scientific interface design inspired by biological archives and museum catalogs. Characterized by high-contrast monospace typography (Courier Prime), a 'paper cream' background (#F7F4ED), and a utilitarian technical grid. This design system is ideal for data-heavy applications, educational platforms, scientific dashboards, and fintech interfaces that require a structured, 'system' feel. It uses a taxonomic color palette for categorical differentiation and employs stark, hard shadows and 2px black borders to define elements. Key features include an interactive SVG phylogenetic tree, scan-line animations, and data-rich tooltips.

structured.summary: A brutalist scientific interface utilizing technical grids, monospace typography, and a 'system-terminal' aesthetic to organize complex taxonomic data.

style.description: The style is 'Scientific Brutalism'. It pairs Courier Prime (monospace) across all hierarchies with a strict color palette: #F7F4ED (Background), #1A1815 (Ink), #C5A059 (Gold), #2D5A27 (Green), #8B7355 (Brown), and #C44536 (Red). Elements use 2px solid black borders and offset hard shadows. Animations are utilitarian: sharp translations (no easing on hover), pulse effects for status indicators, and linear 'scan-line' effects for data visuals.
style.prompt: Create a UI with a #F7F4ED background and a 40px x 40px technical grid (1px lines at 4% opacity). Typography must exclusively be 'Courier Prime'. Use font-size 128px for hero headings with leading-0.85 and tracking-tighter. Component borders should be 2px solid #1A1815. Shadows must be hard-edged (offset 4px to 16px) using #1A1815 or #C5A059. Buttons use a #1A1815 background with white text, transitioning on hover by translating -4px/-4px and adding a 6px hard shadow. Categorical accents: Chordata (#2D5A27), Arthropoda (#8B7355), Mollusca (#C44536). Use 'foreignObject' within SVGs for high-fidelity HTML tooltips featuring data tables and brutalist cards.

layout_and_structure.description: The layout follows a modular block structure with a sticky navigation and defined sections for hero, status alerts, data visualization, and terminal inputs.

prompts.prompt: Sticky header with #F7F4ED background and a 2px bottom border. Left: Logo composed of a 48px square box (#2D5A27) with a white icon and a 4px hard shadow, followed by two-tier monospace text. Right: Navigation links in uppercase mono with wide tracking, separated by 1px vertical dividers. Include a 'Record/Streak' data display in the nav.

Two-column grid (7:5 split). Left: status indicator pill with a pulse animation; giant text (text-8xl+) with highlighted words using a black background and gold text. Right: A 'Specimen Card' floating with a 1-degree rotation, 16px hard shadow, containing an image scan area with a grid overlay and a taxonomic data table.

Large interactive SVG visualization. Vertical/diagonal branching paths using 3px solid lines. Nodes are white rectangles with 2px borders. Color-code branches by phylum (#2D5A27, #8B7355, #C44536). Include 'distance annotations' (e.g., '~530 MYA') rotated 90 degrees along paths. Interaction: Hovering a node reveals a detailed data card (via foreignObject) with a header, ID, and divergence statistics table.

A full-width black banner with a 20px gold hard shadow. Left: A square 'scanner' box with an animated horizontal line and a centered '?' symbol. Center: System status codes and countdown timers in mono. Right: A high-contrast 'ATTEMPT ENTRY' button with a trailing arrow.

Centered input module on a technical grid. Box is #F7F4ED with 16px black shadow. Input field includes a gold '>' prompt, 2px borders, and switches background to 10% green on focus. Beneath the input, include a grid of status square indicators.

special_ui_components.description: A high-density data component mimicking a laboratory log.
special_ui_components.prompt: Container: white background, 2px black border, 16px shadow. Top bar: ID log and rarity tag. Center: Square image area with a 40px grid overlay, scanning-line animation, and 'crosshair' corner marks. Bottom: A data table with 1px border-bottom rows, left-aligned labels (60% opacity), and right-aligned bold data values.

special_ui_components.description: Rich HTML content rendered inside an SVG interactive map.
special_ui_components.prompt: Using SVG 'foreignObject', render a 320px wide card. Header: solid color background (#2D5A27/etc) with white text and 'ID' hex code. Body: white background, 4px internal padding, containing a data table with dotted row dividers. Footer: a secondary background (#F7F4ED) 'Defining Traits' block with a 2px border and uppercase text.

special_ui_components.description: A high-impact button with physical movement feedback.
special_ui_components.prompt: Background #1A1815, text white, padding 24px, uppercase Courier Prime. Transition property: transform 0.1s, box-shadow 0.1s. Hover: transform translate(-4px, -4px), box-shadow 6px 6px 0 #C5A059. Active: translate(0, 0), box-shadow 0 0 0 transparent.
